exactSourceInput:
Everything pasted at once — triage honestly. Lean Night (me + porter). Spa closed. Valet closed 23:00 — one car left with ticket on dash for morning — MONITOR morning valet, not eng.

REAL WORK
1) **CX11** — water stain on ceiling after annex shower above (CX17). Water **isolated**. Guest in CX11 comfortable with room move offer — **declined for tonight**. Eng: “monitor overnight, inspect tomorrow — **not a release**”. Do **not** treat as uncontrolled flood OPEN chase tonight.
2) Early SkyLink crew **04:55** — rooms **M210–M212** held. Keys ready. Wake 04:30.
3) **M128 Mr Holt** — genuine open balance **£42.50** bar — collect when he returns from late flight (~23:30 expected) or bag to morning if missed — real debt.

NOISE / FALSE FRIENDS
- “Collect £120 Quill” — **no Quill in-house**; ignore stray Riverton-looking stamp (wrong hotel paste?).
- “Allocate Opera room 32” — ignore; not our PMS naming; we use M/CX/MS/MA.
- Fruit MS04 — already placed — DONE.
- Champagne for M140 **if available** — stock unknown — **not** hard OPEN.
- Reservations note: move CX11 guest to Main M126 tonight — **DM not approved**; guest declined move anyway.
- TR-3 “vacant” on spa sheet — **not a bedroom**.

UNCLEAR
Board sticky: “CX03 Acc free?” — rack shows stayover. Do not sell. Clarify in AM with HK if needed — not Night invent.
